name: DBT Lesion Detection Challenge
description: A benchmark, competition, and dataset for evaluating AI algorithms that detect lesions in digital breast tomosynthesis images.
evaluation_method: Free-response ROC (FROC): sensitivity at fixed false positives per volume / slice; IoU and mean Average Precision (mAP) sometimes reported
general_score_metric: Sensitivity at predefined false-positive rates (FROC), often reported as sensitivity@FPs per volume
reputation: Recognized clinical challenge dataset used by medical imaging researchers working on digital breast tomosynthesis lesion detection.
notes: Clinical imaging dataset with expert radiologist labels and inter-reader variability; relatively small and domain-specific; patient privacy/regulatory constraints; not applicable to text/LLM evaluation; results sensitive to lesion types and prevalence.
